lines.t: Hi Tom, did the printer for the new office arrive yet?
Not yet. The supplier said it was delayed until Thursday.
Thursday? We need it for the client presentation on Wednesday.
I'll call them and ask if they can send a rental for a few days.

To all staff,
The cafeteria will be closed next Monday ___(1)___ the installation of new kitchen equipment. Coffee and light snacks will be available in the second-floor lounge.
